name: docs-site
category: Documentation · Markdown + config → responsive multi-page static docs site
description: Generate a dark-first, responsive, multi-page, self-contained static documentation site from Markdown content and a small JSON config. Builds the doc structure automatically, wires a configurable navigation menu with a pinned desktop sidebar and a mobile dropdown panel, integrates existing Markdown and data formats, and adds a data list page type with client-side sorting (commit count, last-updated), text filters and status badges. Layout: 860px mobile breakpoint, fixed top bar with GitHub/theme/language controls and a morphing toggle, full-width nav panel with backdrop, fluid content width, a dependency-free mermaid renderer that draws flowcharts and sequence diagrams as inline SVG with a zoom lightbox, light/dark theme and a full EN/中 UI toggle.

runtime: Python 3 standard library only, no pip packages
